title: Pull Vinyl
description: Pull-to-refresh on a feed of Beatles songs. Drag the list down and a record slides out of its sleeve as far as you pull; let go past the line and it spins as the spinner, crackling, until the new songs drop in at the top and it slips back into the sleeve.
intent: The pull-to-refresh gesture made physical and musical, with one over-the-top flourish: the spinner is a record coming out of its sleeve.
